# Louisa Marguerite Christensen

Louisa Marguerite Christensen is a chief physician (Overlæge) with a PhD, working at Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler [^src1]. She is named in the AFDK (Atrieflimren, Danmark) annual report as a member of the database's steering group ("styregruppen"), alongside its other members [^src1].

The mention appears in a section of the AFDK 2024 report (pages 66-70) that covers patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education, describes how Hospitalsenhed Midt has run systematic patient education since 2012, and lists the steering group's membership together with the database's methodological limitations. This section also situates AFDK as a nationwide quality database operating under the Danish Cardiological Society (Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab) and with approval from the Danish Health Authority (Sundhedsstyrelsen) [^src1]. Beyond her listing as a steering group member and her hospital affiliation, no further details about her role, activities, or other claims are available in the corpus.
